justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/MultiBackgroundInitializer.java, src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/package-info.java, src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/MultiBackgroundInitializerTest.java, and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/MultiBackgroundInitializerSupplierTest.java. The class is a focused wrapper over BackgroundInitializer: it has one child map, one inner results type, and only a small fixed set of direct dependencies (Collections, HashMap, Map, NoSuchElementException, Objects, Set, ExecutorService, BackgroundInitializer, ConcurrentException) in lines 19-25 and 96-360. Repo-wide references are limited to these 4 files, with no other production class depending on it, so the fan-in/fan-out is not high enough to qualify as hub-like modularization.
